subject.title: Add gated Claw publication and validation

question: Should ClawHub adopt this persistent, feature-gated Claw package publication contract before the linked Claws RFC is accepted?
rationale: Tests can validate the implementation, but they cannot decide whether ClawHub should permanently own this package family, stored manifest model, CLI surface, and staged lifecycle contract.

options.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep the draft open and disabled until maintainers accept or narrow the Claw package and lifecycle contract, then review the stack in order.

options.title: Sponsor this experiment now
options.body: Explicitly approve the publication and storage boundary as an experimental ClawHub contract before the broader RFC is finalized.

options.title: Narrow the branch
options.body: Retain preparatory validation work but remove persistent package-family and publication surfaces until product direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open and disabled until maintainers accept or narrow the Claw package and lifecycle contract, then review the stack in order.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest discussion-backed routing candidate for the package and lifecycle product-model decision.
